motion.name: button-ease
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: quiet fill swap on button state changes.

headline.purpose: Masthead title and about opener in serif.

label.purpose: History path, banner note, readouts in grotesk.

title.purpose: Panel and section heads in uppercase grotesk.

donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or animation beyond the single button ease.
Don't set controls in serif or story copy in grotesk; the voices don't cross.
Don't put seasonal color, emoji, or decoration in the chrome; expression belongs inside the preview.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics, or brand claims anywhere in the demo copy.
dos: Do keep the shell to paper, ink, and Signal Red.
Do set new instrument text in grotesk and new story text in serif.
Do rule state changes: edition block, section heads, and dividers carry rules.
Do keep the banner visible and sticky in every state.
keyCharacteristics: Broadsheet type, palette, density, and one signature move — never the layout.
Paper ground, black ink, one signal red for edition markers and danger.
Serif for story (masthead, about), grotesk for instrument (toggles, rails, readouts).
The preview frame dominates; chrome above it stays compact and ruled.
narrative.overview: Each season is an edition going to press, and the shell is the composing room. A broadsheet lends this working screen exactly four things: a serif story voice against grotesk rails, a paper ground with black ink and one signal red, dense ruled order, and a single signature move — the edition line, where status and history are set as press furniture between rules.

rules.body: Signal Red marks editions and danger only. Seasonal color lives exclusively inside the café preview, never in the shell.
rules.name: The One Red Rule

rules.body: Serif narrates, grotesk operates. Controls, status, and labels never set in serif; story copy never sets in grotesk.
rules.name: The Two Voices Rule

rules.body: Depth is a rule or a tone step, never a shadow or lift.
rules.name: The Ink-On-Paper Rule
